name: hostinger
description: Connect Hostinger to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Hostinger MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Hostinger to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with hosting, domains and DNS using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Hostinger workspace.
Find anything in Hostinger that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review hosting, domains and DNS in Hostinger.
